model.title: Stopping Political Discrimination in Disaster Assistance Act
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Transportation and Infrastructure Committee · Rep. Scott Perry (R-PA)

summary.text: The bill would add political affiliation to the list of characteristics that cannot be used to discriminate against people receiving federal disaster assistance. It aims to ensure that FEMA and other organizations providing disaster relief treat all individuals fairly regardless of their political beliefs or party affiliation.
